The implementation is complete and verified. Summary of changes:

**New: `src/utils/aws/sts.ts`** — `assumeRoleWithExternalId()` performs `sts:AssumeRole` with the supplied external ID and returns the temporary credentials (throws if STS refuses).

**`src/utils/aws/awsEc2.ts`** — added `describeInstanceInventory(region, creds)`, a throwing `DescribeInstances` read: the exact instance inventory the collection gatherers use.

**New: `src/setting/dto/cloudIAMAuthorizer.ts`** —
- `findCloudIAMProblem()`: a block that names no role → missing-role problem; a blank/whitespace role → nothing to prove (disconnect); otherwise assume-with-external-id, then read the instance inventory with the returned credentials; the failing step is reported.
- `normalizeCloudIAM()`: disconnect persists `{ iamRoleArn: '', externalId: '' }`, i.e. the external ID is cleared.
- `validateCloudIAMForSave()`: throws a `BadRequestException` (body `{statusCode:400, message:[...], error:'Bad Request'}`, plus a useful `error.message`) before anything is written.
- `ValidCloudIAMRoleRule` / `@ValidCloudIAMRole()` class-validator constraint so bad roles are rejected by the validation pipe too (message array contains "IAM").

**`src/setting/dto/update-settings.dto.ts`** — `CloudIAM.iamRoleArn` now carries `@ValidCloudIAMRole()` (still `@IsString()`, so a block naming no role is invalid, never a disconnect).

**`src/setting/settings.service.ts`** — `update()` proves/normalizes `cloudIAM` before `findAll`/`loadPoints`/scheduler/cache work, so a failed check writes nothing else from that save.

**`src/setting/settings.module.ts`** — registers the new rule; **`package.json`** — declares `@aws-sdk/client-sts`.

**`src/setting/cloudIAMScraperRole.spec.ts`** — provisions roles in the local emulator (assumable+EC2 read, assumable without EC2 read, no-external-id) and asserts: good role saved, wrong/missing external ID → 400 with no writes, non-existent role → 400, assumable-but-no-inventory → 400, `cloudIAM: {}` → 400 (not a disconnect), blank role → saved with external ID cleared, and unrelated saves untouched (14 tests pass; the rest of the unit suite is unchanged apart from pre-existing network-dependent failures).
